Relay settings (if joining times out) Use credentials from your TURN provider on both devices, then host/join again.
player 2 gets the other one

build b46 — P1: WASD to move, mouse to aim, hold click to fire. On touch, left half moves and right half aims. Press 2 to drop in a local player 2 (arrow keys + space, or a second gamepad) — that's the same code path the networked player will use. Shift dive-rolls (P2: Ctrl or Enter; two fingers on the move side; A or RB on a pad). R restarts. C calibrates the gun barrels.
